SELECT
  h.hour_of_day,
  COALESCE(a.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(a.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM
  (SELECT generate_series(0,23) AS hour_of_day) AS h
LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS hour_of_day,
      ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue,
      COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM
      orders o
    JOIN
      order_payments op
      ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE
      CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) = CAST('2017-11-24' AS DATE)
    GROUP BY
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::INT
  ) AS a
  USING (hour_of_day)
ORDER BY
  h.hour_of_day;
